questions.question: What is the time taken by a 450 m long train running at 54 km/h to cross a man standing on a platform?
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of the train = 54 kmph

Length of the train = 450m

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

While a train crosses a person, it crosses its own length.

Kilometer per hour (kmph) = 3.6 × Meter per second (mps)

Calculation:

54 km/h = 54 ÷ 3.6 = 15 mps

Time taken by the train to cross the man = 450 ÷ 15 = 30 seconds

∴ A 450m long train running at 54 km/h will take 30 seconds to cross a man standing on a platform.

questions.question: A sum increases by 75% in 10 years at certain rate of simple interest per annum. By what percentage will the same sum increase in 6 years at the same rate of simple interest per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In Simple Interest, the percentage increase is directly proportional to the time period.

Percentage increase in 10 years = 75%

Percentage increase in 1 year = 75% ÷ 10 = 7.5%

Percentage increase in 6 years = 7.5% × 6 = 45%

**∴ The correct answer is 45%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A sum increases by 75% in 10 years at simple interest.

Time (T₁) = 10 years, Time (T₂) = 6 years.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 
 
 6 Years (SI = ?)
 Remaining 4 Years
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total 10 Years: SI = 75% increase
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 6 Years: SI = 45% increase

**Calculation:**

Let the principal (P) be 100.

⇒ Since the sum increases by 75%, Simple Interest for 10 years = 75.

⇒ 75 = (100 × R × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 75 = 10R

⇒ R = 7.5% per annum

Now, calculate the SI for 6 years at the same rate of interest:

⇒ New SI = (100 × 7.5 × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ New SI = 7.5 × 6

⇒ New SI = 45

⇒ Since the principal is 100, an SI of 45 means the sum increases by 45%.

**∴ The correct answer is 45%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion in Simple Interest

For a fixed principal and constant rate, the interest earned is directly proportional to the time period (SI ∝ T). You can directly use the ratio: SI₁ ÷ T₁ = SI₂ ÷ T₂.

Percentage Increase

When a problem states that a sum increases by a certain percentage, that percentage increase is exactly equal to the Simple Interest accumulated. Amount = Principal + SI.

Rate of Interest

Rate per annum (R) can be determined efficiently by isolating it from the SI formula: R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T).

questions.question: The marginal propensity to consume (MPC) refers to the:

options.text: rate of change of consumption as income changes
change in savings per unit change in income

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**rate of change of consumption as income changes​.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marginal propensity to consume** refers to the **change in consumption** with respect to the **change in income**.
 
• When there is an **increase in income** it **reflects in better purchasing power** of a consumer.
 
• The **change in income** not only **affects consumption** but also induces **changes in savings**.
 
• The **proportion of consumption depends upon the income levels** and corresponding necessities of the consumer.
 
• It is used widely in economics to calculate the required additional production for the increased demand(consumption).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The complement of the **MPC( Marginal propensity to Consume)** is **Marginal Propensity to Save(MPS)**.
 
• They both reflect the increase in income.
 
• 
 
Marginal Propensity To Consume (MPC)- 

 
In economics, the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) is defined as the proportion of an aggregate raise in pay that a consumer spends on the consumption of goods and services, as opposed to saving it. The marginal propensity to consume is a component of Keynesian macroeconomic theory and is calculated as the change in consumption divided by the change in income. 

 
The marginal propensity to consume is equal to ΔC / ΔY, where ΔC is the change in consumption, and ΔY is the change in income. If consumption increases by 80 cents for each additional dollar of income, then MPC is equal to 0.8 / 1 = 0.8.

questions.question: Find the HCF of 245, 175 and 385.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **HCF** of a set of numbers is always a factor of the **difference** between any two of those numbers.

Step 1: Find the smallest difference between the given numbers: 245 − 175 = **70**.

Step 2: List the factors of 70 in descending order: 70, **35**, 14, 10, 7, 5, 2, 1.

Step 3: Check divisibility. 70 does not divide 175. However, **35** divides 175 (35 × 5), 245 (35 × 7), and 385 (35 × 11).

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The numbers are **175**, **245**, and **385**.

**Formula Used:** **HCF** = Product of the lowest power of all common prime factors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ab4676f0f9d7541b4ae59efc7345ff24a1522bab7a885d70b77448b02182e71.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 175 = 5 × 5 × 7 = 5² × 7¹

⇒ Prime factorization of 245 = 5 × 7 × 7 = 5¹ × 7²

⇒ Prime factorization of 385 = 5 × 7 × 11 = 5¹ × 7¹ × 11¹

⇒ Common prime factors are **5** and **7**.

⇒ **HCF** = 5¹ × 7¹ = 35.

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

**__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

Also known as GCF (Greatest Common Factor), it is the largest integer that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder.

Successive Division Method

A systematic way to find the HCF of large numbers by dividing the larger number by the smaller one until the remainder is zero.

HCF of Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers have no common factors other than 1, they are called co-prime, and their **HCF** is always 1.

Relation with LCM

For any two numbers a and b: HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b.</p

• Basic/Key Industries (Public-cum-Private Sector) - This included coal, iron and steel, aircraft manufacture, shipbuilding, manufacture of telephone, telegraphs and wireless apparatus, and mineral oils. New undertakings in this category could be started only by the state government.

questions.question: ______ is an order or order given by a superior court to a subordinate court or tribunal or public authority, to do so if it is not discharging its duty.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Mandamus'** means - **We Command.**
 
• It is an order from the Supreme Court or High Court **to a lower court or tribunal or public authority to perform a public or statutory duty if it is not discharging its duty.**
 
• There are **five writs** that can be issued by the Supreme Court of India and the High Court of India - **Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Quo Warranto, and Certiorari.**

questions.question: One-seventh of a 2-digit number is 15 less than half of the number. What is the sum of the digits of the 2-digit number?

Assume the 2-digit number is 14 units (LCM of 2 and 7).

One-seventh of the number = 14 ÷ 7 = 2 units.

Half of the number = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 units.

The difference is 7 units − 2 units = 5 units.

questions.question: A man can do a work in 20 days and a woman can do the same work in 30 days. In how many days will 2 men and 3 women do the work?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Efficiency** of 1 **Man** = 1/20 and 1 **Woman** = 1/30.

Required **Efficiency** for 2 **Men** and 3 **Women** = (2 × 1/20) + (3 × 1/30).

⇒ 1/10 + 1/10 = 2/10 = 1/5.

Total **Time** taken = Reciprocal of combined efficiency = 5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by one **man** = 20 days

Time taken by one **woman** = 30 days

**Formula Used:**

**Total Work** = **Efficiency** × **Time**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 1 Man
 20
 60 (LCM of 20, 30)
 3
 
 

 1 Woman
 30
 2
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Total Work** = LCM(20, 30) = 60 units.

⇒ **Efficiency** of 1 **man** = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/day.

⇒ **Efficiency** of 1 **woman** = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 units/day.

⇒ **Efficiency** of 2 **men** = 2 × 3 = 6 units/day.

⇒ **Efficiency** of 3 **women** = 3 × 2 = 6 units/day.

⇒ Combined **Efficiency** (2 **men** + 3 **women**) = 6 + 6 = 12 units/day.

⇒ **Time** required = **Total Work** ÷ **Total Efficiency**

⇒ **Time** = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relationship

**Efficiency** is inversely proportional to the **time** taken to complete a task. Efficiency = 1 ÷ Time.

Combined Work Formula

If A takes 'x' days and B takes 'y' days, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days to finish the **work**.

Area of Δ**OBC** = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 8 × 4 = 16 cm².

questions.question: If 3x + 2y = 13 and y² - 4y + 4 = 0, then find (x, y)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The second equation y² − 4y + 4 = 0 directly factors into a perfect square: (y − 2)² = 0.

This gives y = 2 immediately without calculation.

Substitute y = 2 mentally into the first equation: 3x + 2(2) = 13.

3x + 4 = 13 ⇒ 3x = 9 ⇒ x = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is (3, 2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: 3x + 2y = 13

Equation 2: y² − 4y + 4 = 0

**Calculations:**

⇒ y² − 4y + 4 = 0

⇒ y² − 2y − 2y + 4 = 0

⇒ y(y − 2) − 2(y − 2) = 0

⇒ (y − 2)(y − 2) = 0

⇒ y = 2

Substitute the value of y in Equation 1:

⇒ 3x + 2(2) = 13

⇒ 3x + 4 = 13

⇒ 3x = 13 − 4

⇒ 3x = 9

⇒ x = 3

Hence, the coordinates (x, y) are (3, 2).

**∴ The correct answer is (3, 2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective CI for 3 years at 20% = 72.8%

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3500.**

⇒ 448 = P × (16/125)

⇒ P = (448 × 125) ÷ 16

⇒ P = 28 × 125

⇒ P = 3500

questions.question: The mean of the observations 29, 36, 21, 18, 7, 19, k, k is 21.25 and the mode of the observations 29, 22, 15, 15, 22, 18, 21, p, p is 29. Find the value of (p - k ).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of 8 observations = 21.25 × 8 = 170.

Sum of given 6 numbers (29, 36, 21, 18, 7, 19) = 130. ∴ 2k = 170 − 130 = 40 ⇒ k = 20.

For the mode to be 29 in the second set, 29 must appear more times than any other number. ∴ p = 29.

Value of (p − k) = 29 − 20 = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Mean of (29, 36, 21, 18, 7, 19, k, k) = 21.25. Mode of (29, 22, 15, 15, 22, 18, 21, p, p) = 29.

**Formula Used:** **Mean** = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations); **Mode** = Observation with the highest frequency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1542401b6362badc3979043b297e634ed072ee4a287772fc7793728d9d204f2.png] 

**Calculation for k:**

⇒ (29 + 36 + 21 + 18 + 7 + 19 + k + k) ÷ 8 = 21.25

⇒ (130 + 2k) = 21.25 × 8

⇒ 130 + 2k = 170

⇒ 2k = 170 − 130 = 40

⇒ k = 20

**Calculation for p:**

⇒ Observations: 29, 22, 15, 15, 22, 18, 21, p, p

⇒ Frequencies without p: 15 (2 times), 22 (2 times), 29 (1 time), 18 (1 time), 21 (1 time).

⇒ Since the **Mode** is 29, the number 29 must have the highest frequency.

⇒ If p = 29, the frequency of 29 becomes 1 + 2 = 3 times.

⇒ ∴ p = 29

**Finding (p − k):**

⇒ 29 − 20 = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. Formula: Mean = (Σxᵢ) ÷ n.

Mode of Data

The value that appears most frequently in a data set. A set can be unimodal, bimodal, or multimodal.

Empirical Relation

The relationship between central tendencies: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.</p

questions.question: A right circular cone is surmounted on a hemisphere. Base radius of the cone is equal to radius of the hemisphere. The diameter of the hemisphere is 12 cm while the height of the cone is 8 cm. Find the cost of painting the compound object if it costs ₹25 to paint π cm².
questions.solution:
Given:

A right circular cone is surmounted on a hemisphere. Base radius of the cone is equal to radius of the hemisphere.

The diameter of the hemisphere is 12 cm while the height of the cone is 8 cm. 

Concept used:

Slant height = sqrt{Radius² + Height²}

Curved surface area of a sphere = 4π (Radius)²

Curved surface area of a cone = π × Radius × Slant Height

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2f87fe3f2ccdd4f0dbd5516ee2332c9879296b63de82ea5383e008c70143163.png] 

Radius = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

Since the right circular cone is surmounted on a hemisphere, the** area of the base = 2π × 6² = 72π cm²**

Slant Height = sqrt{6² + 8²} = 10 cm

Hence, the total surface area of the cone surmounted on the hemisphere

⇒ Curved surface area of the cone + area of the base

⇒ π × 6 × 10 + 72π

⇒ 132π 

Thus, the cost of painting the compound object = (25 × 132π) ÷ π = ₹3300

**∴ The cost of painting the compound object is ₹3300.**
